・These outputs consist on the complete library code, allowing us to use the code to prove it's functional state.
・the most usefull data listener function is the transaction hash list one, because this one is the function used for awaiting for incoming to-be-signed transactions, but we decided to add extra optional listeners for all kind of items (transaction, transaction witness as well) to give freedom to developers and avoid opinionating use cases based on our own former needs.
・In order to facilitate community verification of the functioning state of the library we submitted PoA2 and work of PoA3 together, providing tangible means to test the library with the promised React example dapp and another optional one we are including for nodeJs developers.

・getTxHex function retrieves the full data of a transaction by it's transaction hash (ID), this data usually will be validated to decide whether or not to sign or not a transaction
・setVkWitnessHex function allows to share through Unimatrix a transaction signature.

ms.criteria:
(1) Example dapp will be able to listen, validate and sign Cardano multisignature transactions on user's browser
(2) Example dapp will be able to listen, validate and sign Cardano multisignature transactions on backend / linux environment
ms.report:
On a Github repository:
(1) Complete frontend Unimatrix Sync validator and signer node example dapp in React, 
・It listen, validate and sign Cardano multi-signature/deferred signature transactions on user's browser. 
・It has 3 different example use cases on same dapp: 
・Batch transaction signing: 3 transactions being signed and submitted at once on user wallet, showing how multi-transaction signing works with GC Wallet and Unimatrix Sync in tandem on client side
・decentralized token sale: a token being minted on user wallets on a multisig transaction with Unimatrix Sync on client side
・decentralized NFT sale: an NFT being minted on user wallets on a multisig transaction with Unimatrix Sync on client side
・Also serves as passive monitor or "hub" for multisig users to live-sync and manually sign their multisig transactions 
・For Cardano mainnet and Pre-production testnet.
・Ideal funtional and styled boilerplate with modern library dependencies like React-Vite for start developing client side dapps or services with Unimatrix Sync and GC Wallet 
・Using cardano-serialization-lib
・A screenshot of it's functional state. 
・A provisional online deployment here for reviewing purposes. 

(2) Backend Unimatrix Sync validator and signer node example dapp in NodeJs,
・It listen, validate and sign Cardano multi-signature/deferred signature transactions on backend / linux environment. 
・For Cardano mainnet and Pre-production testnet.
・Using cardano-serialization-lib
・A screenshot of it's functional state. 
・This is an extra offering outside proposal scope of an example for backend developers.
・Ideal boilerplate for start developing backend dapps and services with Unimatrix Sync and GC Wallet 

Milestone comments: 
・This PoA was released together with PoA 2 to facilitate reviewing process as PoA 2 output is already the fully working library and this one requires Unimatrix Sync to work. 
・Documentation for library and examples is coming soon on next PoA.
